inlines.v: BULL'ETIN, noun A French word denoting 1. An official report from an officer to his commander or superior. 2. An official report of a physician respecting the king's health. 3. A little note given by a banking company. 4. It is sometimes used for a notice, or public announcement; as a bibliographical bulletin
